name: What is the real timeline for a luxury home in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How long does a high-end custom home really take to build in Los Angeles, including design and permitting?
mainEntity.text: How long does a high-end custom home really take to build in Los Angeles, including design and permitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The full timeline for a luxury home in Los Angeles usually includes design, engineering, permitting, procurement, and construction, not just the build phase. Complex custom homes can move slowly because each stage depends on the one before it. Design refinement, structural planning, and permit review can take months before work begins in the field. Construction itself can also stretch if the home includes custom steel, stone, millwork, imported materials, or specialty systems. Site conditions matter too: sloped lots, limited access, and tight urban sites can slow progress. Homeowners should ask for a schedule that separates preconstruction from active construction and identifies long-lead items early. The best schedules are milestone-based and updated regularly, so delays are visible before they become expensive. In luxury residential work, the schedule is not just a calendar; it is a coordination tool.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury home in Los Angeles often takes much longer than the actual construction period alone. Design, consultant coordination, permit review, and construction can together take years on complex projects. Hillside sites, custom details, and neighborhood approvals can extend the schedule significantly.
